title: Reject invalid canvas size before starting a new drawing
goal: The new-drawing dialog offers only the supported preset sizes (16 to 128 pixels square), so no out-of-range size can be entered; Keep Drawing cancels it and the original drawing and name remain exactly.
cliOnly: numeric 0 and 513 entry, which only the Canvas size dialog accepts (covered by S4-HIST-04)

steps.why: Only supported preset sizes are offered.
The original project is still open.
